label: One round of refinement
subgoals: Assign initial colours by device type and net degree
Form each vertex's signature from its colour and its labelled neighbour colours

label: Rounds until stable
subgoals: Recompute signatures with the previous round's colours
Compare the new class count with the old one
Stop when a round splits no class

label: The stable partition
subgoals: Run refinement to its fixed point
Count the classes of the stable partition
Mark singleton classes as matched vertices
